paper_title: Axion and neutrino bounds improved with new calibrations of the tip of the red-giant branch using geometric distance determinations
notes: TRGB (tip of red-giant branch) stellar-cooling bound on the axion-electron Yukawa coupling g_ae. The paper's most restrictive bound, from the globular cluster omega Centauri, is g_ae < 1.3e-13 (95% CL), quoted in the abstract and Table I (g13 = g_ae/1e-13, 68%/95% columns); NGC 4258 gives the slightly weaker 1.6e-13. The omega Cen value is reported here as the headline (the paper calls mu_12 < 1.2, equivalently g13 < 1.3, its 'most restrictive new bound'). The limit is mass-independent for axion masses well below the degenerate He-core temperature (~10 keV), so it is rendered as a flat line; the paper does not state an explicit mass range. No dark-matter density assumption (stellar energy-loss argument).
